_readme: Per-slot corrections to the NFS4 ambience, made by ear in game (HS13/HS14).
Key is '<nfs4 track>/<tram slot>', lower case. Fields, all optional:
interval_s  seconds between repeats; on a loop zone it also strips the
loop points, turning a short looping sample into an
intermittent one (a 1 s bird chirp reads as a stuck sample
when PU loops it back to back)
range       audible radius in metres, overriding LOOP_RANGE/POINT_RANGE
spacing     metres between the points of a loop chain
volume      PU volume 0..100, overriding the converted NFS4 volume
Anything not listed here is converted straight from the NFS4 tables.
